# Atomik Trading Documentation

> Official documentation for Atomik Trading (https://atomiktrading.io) — software that runs automated trading strategies in futures accounts customers hold in their own name. A customer picks a strategy from the marketplace by its record, builds one with AI inside the platform, or sends TradingView alerts; Atomik's servers place the orders at the customer's broker, 24/7. Non-custodial, no VPS, no code required. Futures trading carries a substantial risk of loss; nothing here promises results.

Main site: https://atomiktrading.io
Pricing: https://atomiktrading.io/pricing
Marketplace (public; each strategy's record from its live signals): https://atomiktrading.io/marketplace
Machine-readable overview of the product: https://www.atomiktrading.io/llms.txt

## Facts worth getting right

- Pricing (USD): Free $0 (paper only, 1 paper account) · Starter $89/mo · Pro $129/mo · Elite $349/mo. Yearly: Starter $890, Pro $1,290, Elite $3,490 (Elite yearly is arranged by email, no online checkout). Flat price: no per-trade fees, no share of results.
- Try it on paper first, free and with no card. When you go live, every paid plan has a 7-day money-back guarantee on the first payment.
- Brokers: Tradovate (demo + live; the route in for many prop/funded accounts), TopstepX (direct, API key), Interactive Brokers (IB username and password), plus a built-in paper-trading simulator ($100k virtual). No crypto exchanges.
- Marketplace records: each strategy has one record, from its own live signals at the signal price (not a backtest, not subscribers' broker fills), on one fixed market (the one it has traded most, never switched; a creator can declare one going forward only), at 1 contract, before fees and slippage. Rows that can't be real trades are left out. Losing trades and weeks stay. A strategy is ranked "Steadiest" only with 8+ weeks and 20+ trades on the record and a positive net; newer ones are tagged "Building a record". Real fills can differ.
- Non-custodial: Atomik connects to the user's own broker account and never holds funds.
